title: Audit final CCP2 publication and stable references
description:
Scope: CCP revision/index references in /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/spec/drafts/draft-lichen-link-01.md and /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/spec/README.md, plus the final evidence contract in /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/docs/ccp-conformance.md. Audit all scoped documentation deliverables against the reviewed wire, frozen independent corpus, joined software/admission evidence and exact RF/authority dispositions. Independently inspect project-LICHEN-worker6-7kzp's stable initialization references against CCP2 instead of trusting old closure status. Do not expand into unrelated coverage, optional experimental completion or source-policy reapproval.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: This sibling publication gate waits on actual documentation leaves, the docs.06 reuse alias and concrete software/qualification dispositions, never its own rollup or a parent-to-child blocking edge. Existing xzen deliverables are checked through the reviewed wire gate, not issue metadata alone.
acceptance_criteria: All 26 CCP2 requirement IDs, draft/index links, source/corpus versions, configuration tuples and evidence artifacts agree. Local link/identifier/structure checks and independent document review find no unresolved false claims or stale density-driven CH0/SF/continuous-reception instructions treated as current. The reused 7kzp deliverable states stable protocol dependencies compatible with the finalized CCP2 time contract; AGENTS line numbers are not normative authority. Missing/no-go evidence stays explicit, optional experiments may remain not assessed, and software success is never presented as RF/grant approval.
